value_or_angle: header="Drowned in the Winooski at six" body="Charles was born in Vermont in 1803, the son of Polly Cadwell and her first husband, Charles Plum. In 1809, at about six, he drowned in the Winooski River." category=death

header="Two husbands and a drowned son" body="Polly married Charles Plum about 1800 and bore Charles and Betsey. In 1809 her son Charles drowned in the Winooski, and that March she married Thomas Larned Munsell of Whitehall, New York. She died at Montpelier in October 1840." category=family

header="From Hartford's West District to Montpelier" body="Mary and Aaron Cadwell lived on the line between Hartford's West District and Wintonbury, where all their children were born. About 1800 they moved to Hartland, Vermont, then to Montpelier, where Mary died in October 1842, at eighty-seven." category=family
